rationale: Discharge-only plan maximizes critical-load energy. With dispatch steps (ev_a 4 kW, ev_b 3 kW) and 0.5 h intervals, each EV can drain at most 6.6667 kWh above reserve (20/3 kWh), delivering 6.0 kWh at 0.9 discharge efficiency, for a fleet maximum of 12.0 kWh. The schedule keeps per-interval net discharge within critical load (t1 8<=10, t2 10<=12, t3 6<=9) and SOC above reserve.
